sentences.text: Clothes and accessories are where your regrets live: 3 of 5 clothes buys and 3 of 4 accessories you reviewed went badly. Books never have.
sentences.evidence: clothes 3 of 5, accessories 3 of 4, books 0 of 3, eating out 2 of 5

sentences.text: Between 11pm and 2am you regret almost everything you buy. Six of the seven late-night purchases you reviewed were regrets.
Friday after 10pm is the worst hour of your week. Five purchases, five regrets.
The two days after a shift pays are busier and riskier: 4 of the 7 purchases you reviewed in those windows were regrets, against 9 of 20 overall.
sentences.evidence: 7 reviewed within 48h of payday, 4 regretted; 20 reviewed overall, 9 regretted

sentences.text: Under a sale, countdown or only-2-left banner you regretted 7 of 8 purchases. Without one, 2 of 12.
sentences.evidence: 8 reviewed with a cue, 7 regretted; 12 without, 2 regretted

sentences.text: You own two phone cases and two pairs of earbuds. The second of each was a late-night order, and the second case was a regret.
sentences.evidence: p_02 and p_10 phone cases; p_04 and p_14 earbuds

sentences.text: I'm 81% tuned to you, up from 64% a month ago. Accessories is where I've learned most.

pressure.sentence: With a sales cue on the page you regretted 88% of purchases. Without one, 17%.
